oral_examination.oral_examination: 1. The face is slightly asymmetrical from left to right, with the right cheek being plump; the upper and lower labia are protruding on the side; the mandibular joint mobility is normal on both sides, the opening is three fingers horizontally, the opening is toward the middle and lower, and there is no tenderness or snapping in the joint area; 2. The permanent dentition in the mouth has rounded apexes in the upper and lower dental arches, and the front and middle segments of the upper and lower dentitions are crowded; 3. The mesial relationship of the bilateral molars, the front teeth crossbite, and the midlines of the upper and lower dentitions are uneven; 4. Oral hygiene is average, There is no obvious redness, swelling, abnormality or soft scale in the gums;

source_handle: Parents fill in medical records and retain a full set of orthodontic information about their children (intraoral photos, facial photos, 3D models, curved tomographic films, and lateral cephalograms) for orthodontic diagnosis and analysis.
